topic: Real business: PepsiCo snacks market estimate, consolidated net revenue, geographic reach
scope_note: Global snacks-market estimate is not directly comparable to PepsiCo consolidated beverages-and-food revenue. No market-share calculation.

slides.heading: PEPSICO KA GLOBAL REACH
slides.body: 2025 filing: PepsiCo beverages aur convenient foods 200+ countries aur territories tak pahunchte hain.

slides.heading: SNACKS MARKET $747.6B
slides.body: 2025 global snacks market estimate: USD $747.6 billion. Ye poori category hai, sirf PepsiCo nahi.

slides.heading: NET REVENUE $93.925B
slides.body: PepsiCo FY2025 consolidated net revenue: USD $93.925 billion. Ismein snacks aur beverages dono hain.

slides.heading: DO BUSINESS STREAMS
slides.body: PepsiCo snacks aur drinks dono bechta hai. Company revenue ko snacks-only market se seedha compare na karo.

slides.heading: NUMBERS KA SCOPE
slides.body: Market estimate: global snacks. Revenue: poori PepsiCo. Footprint: 200+ countries/territories. Market share yahan calculate nahi hota.
